scope: Proposition 13.1 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 84. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, B) be a globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold pair, with B effective and rational, (X, B) klt, and D = KX +B rational Cartier and analytically pseudo-effective. Suppose there is a projective log resolution p : W → X, with W smooth and compact Kähler, such that W is non-uniruled or Moishezon. Then there exist a smooth compact Kähler manifold U, a projective modification r : U → X, an analytically nef rational holomorphic line bundle MU , and an effective rational divisor N on X such that, for the rational b-line bundle M determined by MU , D ∼Q N + MX. (13.1) The equivalence is an identity of actual rational reflexive sheaves.
